variety_description: A high yielding, medium maturity, medium height, extra long slender grain variety grown extensively in North India. Developed by PAU and released in 2013. Highly adapted to irrigated lowlands. Erect plant with sturdy stem. Popular variety due to yield stability across environments. Resistant to leaf blight due to introgression of three major resistant genes.
